title: Koru Feature
description: A single normalized and classified map object. GeoJSON Feature with a fixed, Koru-defined 'properties' shape.

subclass.description: Finer classification within the class, snake_case (e.g. 'motorway', 'residential', 'river').

name.description: Human-readable name from the source, if any.

source_ref.description: Stable reference to the original object: '<provider>:<native id>' (e.g. 'openstreetmap:way/123').

attributes.description: Class-specific normalized attributes with snake_case keys (e.g. lanes, height_m, zone_density).

FeatureClass.title: Feature class
FeatureClass.description: Top-level Koru taxonomy. Owned by the generalization team; changes follow the contract-change process (docs/data-model.md).

oneOf.description: Road and street network for vehicles or pedestrians, including paths.
Water bodies and waterways: sea, lakes, rivers, canals.
Landforms and elevation features: contours, cliffs, peaks.
Land use and urban planning zones: residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural.
Forests, parks, grassland and other vegetated areas.
Points of interest: services, landmarks, amenities.
Normalized but not yet classified. Valid output that consumers should not rely on.
